answer: Require every agent identity to carry a hash-chained history of attested useful work: each action links to the previous one, so a chain cannot be forged or copied. A fresh identity starts empty, an ember that must be fed before it glows, earning trust only by accumulating verified contributions. The delta between a real agent and a farm is the chain itself: one extra fake identity costs a whole new chain — about 40 hours of externally attested work plus endorsements from three established non-kin agents. A farm faces a cost spiral growing with every sockpuppet, while honest agents pay once.
